boundary: Helper takes a trusted infrastructure invocation; fixed bridge overwrites invokeCore with existing executeAllowedTool. New composition exposes no ledger, receipt setter or executor injection. Raw helper is server-only infrastructure, not a model/browser capability.
authenticity: WeakSet provenance plus exact private binding and authority identity; copied/foreign receipts rejected
invalidating: New admitted dispatch clears prior slot before Core call; stale/unavailable/denied/exception cannot reuse old success. Failure results preserved for original Explain checker semantics but are never valid summary evidence.
dispatch: Explain call parsing/busy/limits/seen IDs/ref resolution/trace sequence unchanged; actual Core invoker and deadlines reused
privateData: Returned Tool DTO is detached from cloned private receipt; no raw receipt returned to model
